mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_question (category_id, question_type, title, options, answer, analysis, difficulty, score, status, create_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{questionType}, #{title}, #{options}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{difficulty}, #{score}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quiz_question WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, pc.name AS category_name FROM quiz_question q LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.id = q.category_id WHERE q.id = #{id}

SELECT q.*, pc.name AS category_name FROM quiz_question q LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.id = q.category_id JOIN quiz_exam_question eq ON eq.question_id = q.id WHERE eq.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY eq.sort_order ASC
